summary: The agent failed verification despite producing what appeared to be correct outputs. The trace shows the agent followed all documented patterns from spreadsheet-audit-reporting skill correctly: proper sheet structure, computed columns, summary aggregation with Grand Total, and Word brief generation. The failure appears to be in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite which suggests the verifier may have specific expectations not fully captured in the skill documentation. The agent correctly identified the cycle count audit pattern as similar to returns disposition and outbound manifest audits (composite key matching, missing final event detection, approval/escalation gap detection). The skill needs enhancement to cover: (1) cycle count variance audit as a known invariant sub-task, (2) explicit handling of NULL/None count quantities in FINAL events as valid missing final count indicators, (3) variance threshold calculations for approval gaps, and (4) the specific 4-sheet structure with Overview preservation from template.
